source.text: If a single accepted purchase order covers 35 or more units of Equipment, the Buyer shall receive a price adjustment equal to 6.5% of the otherwise applicable amount for the eligible units in that order.
The Buyer shall pay each correctly issued and undisputed invoice within 55 days of the invoice date, subject to the retention and dispute provisions of this Agreement.

issues.quote: 5.8 Delay and liquidated damages. Where the Vendor delivers the relevant Equipment after the delivery date specified in clause 5.2, the Vendor shall owe the Buyer liquidated damages equal to 7.5% of the invoice value for that delayed delivery. The Parties acknowledge that this amount is intended as a single agreed sum for the relevant delay and not as a recurring daily amount.
